text:
Kathy: La Cosecha empanada run? They close at 3pm. Thinking of leaving at 2:15 — happy to pick up if people want.
Diego: yes pls. Beef x2, spinach x1. I'll Venmo.
Ava: I'm in. Add one spinach for me.
Maya: can we get an oatmilk latte for the office too? Also need a yogurt.
Luca: I'll be remote but can Venmo Diego. Anyone need gluten-free?
skack-bot: Fridge inventory snapshot: Oatmilk: 2L, Whole milk: 1L, Yogurt (plain): 3, Granola bars: 10, Coffee beans: ~15% left. 
Kathy: Cool — tally: beef x2, spinach x2, yogurt x1, oatmilk latte x1. Anyone else?
Ava: Add 1 ham & cheese please. Also FYI there's a jam jar in the sink since Monday :grimacing: can we label?
Diego: I'll place the order on their takeout page and pick up at 2:30. Send $5 to @diego-venmo pls.
FinanceBot: Quick reminder — personal reimbursements over $20 should go through Expensely. Small covers are fine in Venmo.
Maya: sent $5.
Luca: sent $5.
Ava: sent; accidentally added a tip for Kathy lol.
Kathy: thanks! Diego, can you also warm up the espresso machine when you're back? mine's cold.
Diego: will do. ETA ~2:45.
Kathy: two quick pantry notes — please put creamer back on fridge shelf 2 (not counter) and label leftovers with name+date.
Ava: agreed. Also can we adopt a 'no open almond milk' rule? it goes off quick.
skack-bot: New fridge sticker printed — "Label Your Leftovers". Sticker location: pantry shelf 1. Link: https://img.redwood.infer/empanada-sticker.png
Diego: pickup complete. Leaving on front desk in a brown bag. Hot and ready.
Maya: thank you!! :heart:
Kathy: post-run update — empanadas still hot, espresso machine fixed :thumbsup: Please remember the labeling so we don't end up with mystery meals.
